plan: In a theatrical dressing room before an adult magic-show event at night, tidying her established bob with one hand beside the cheek and the other holding a small plain ribbon below shoulder level. Warm mirror bulbs. Both hands inside the frame.

Original yellow satin magician-event costume: opaque structured cream bustier with a low secure neckline, cropped sleeveless yellow waistcoat, separate black wrist cuffs, short tailored black skirt. Small duck-shaped gold pendant. Bare shoulders and midriff. No hat, armor or weapon.

Kneeling on a dry wooden platform at an aquatic research hatchery in cool morning light, testing water with a clear vial held at eye level; the other hand rests open on her own knee. Side profile with her whole body, bare hands and the glass tanks readable.
Ivory sleeveless utility romper with short legs and a zipped yellow belt pouch, low rubber shoes, tiny duck pendant; opaque breathable fabric, bare arms and legs.

Returning home through a wet train-station arcade at blue hour, pausing mid-step and turning her shoulders toward warm lights, carrying a closed compact umbrella downward in one hand and lightly holding a bag strap with the other. Head to above knees.

Mustard short-sleeved button blouse tied at the natural waist over an opaque cream camisole, high-waist navy A-line short skirt and ankle boots, small duck pendant. Bare forearms, a narrow midriff strip and legs.
